notes.title: Invincible Presents: Atom Eve Patch #1 is available now!
notes.notes:
A new update is available for [i]Invincible Presents: Atom Eve[/i]! This patch includes various bug fixes and improvements.

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that caused text boxes and bubbles to occasionally shrink, causing text to spill out
[*] Fixed minor visual issues with text bubbles across multiple scenes
[*] Fixed an issue that could allow multiple instances of the skill tree to be opened
[*] Fixed an issue that could lock the map if the player clicked on a second map location before the first one loaded
[*] Fixed an issue that could cause elements of the HUD and icons to flicker when hovering
[*] Adjusted the size of CRIT text in some languages
[*] Adjusted the offset for shield effects to prevent possible overlapping of adjacent enemies
[*] Fixed multiple issues related to missing killing a target during shield break
[*] Fixed an issue that could prevent the "No Holding Back" achievement from unlocking
[*] Fixed a softlock caused by trying to go to multiple unintended scenes
[*] Fixed an issue causing Killcannon's charged attack to have the wrong icon
[*] Fixed focus issues when using the menu on keyboard and mouse
[/list]


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2060870



[h2]What is [i]Invincible Presents: Atom Eve?[/i][/h2]
[i]Invincible Presents: Atom Eve[/i] is a visual novel with an original story, turn-based combat, and RPG elements. What that means is this is a game that lets you play as Atom Eve and you can make decisions that affect both Eve’s relationships with her friends and family and how events in the storyline play out. It’s our way to put you in control of your own Atom Eve comic book story.

Experience an original story with striking art directed by Rossi Gifford and creative direction by award-winning writer Jill Murray, and explore the life of Atom Eve in a world filled with beloved characters. Based on the comic book by Robert Kirkman, Cory Walker, and Ryan Ottley.

notes.title: It's an Atom Eve world - Community Update #1
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Welcome to the first of our Community Updates for [i]Invincible Presents: Atom Eve[/i], the first original Invincible game from Skybound Games. Through these updates we want to give the community the latest news, showcase exclusive art, provide insights from development, and answer community questions directly here on Steam.


[h1]Atom Eve @ San Diego Comic-Con[/h1]

We revealed our brand new game for the first time to all the Invincible fans who attended the Invincible 20th Anniversary Panel at SDCC on July 21, 2023. Maybe you were there? Watch the trailer below if you missed it!

[previewyoutube=aEprU8gDXKU;full][/previewyoutube]
The same day, the long-anticipated release date for Invincible Season 2 was finally revealed. Yes, Season 2 is coming to Prime Video on November 3... But that wasn’t all!

A [url=https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0C8Y1M9MB/]Special Episode[/url] about Atom Eve’s origin story was also announced, and released the same evening on Prime Video alongside a special screening for SDCC attendees! If you haven’t watched that yet… go ahead and do that. We’ll wait.

[previewyoutube=IQmHQLpUrAo;full][/previewyoutube]
 
[h1]About the Game[/h1]

We’ll have a lot more to show and tell until launch, but we want to answer some common questions we’ve seen in this first Community Update.

[h3]What kind of game is this?[/h3]
[i]Invincible Presents: Atom Eve[/i] is a visual novel with an original story, turn-based combat, and RPG elements. What that means is this is a game that lets you play as Atom Eve and you can make decisions that affect both Eve’s relationships with her friends and family and how events in the storyline play out. It’s our way to put you in control of your own Atom Eve comic book story.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44402017/e825fc4d83e47cd29fb05e8037c3846e819bf124.png[/img]
[h3]I’ve seen the Invincible animated series but I haven’t read the comics, does that matter?[/h3]
You don’t have to have read the comics to fully enjoy the story in this game. If you [i]have[/i] read the comics, however, you’ll be able to learn new details about characters from the comics, as well as get more background story on some characters that didn’t get a lot of time to shine in the comics before.

[h3]I don’t know anything about Invincible![/h3]
That’s fine too! [i]Invincible Presents: Atom Eve[/i] works as a standalone game and we don’t presume prior knowledge of all things Invincible for any player. We recommend you watch the series, though! It’s awesome! (But we may be a little biased here...)

[h3]Is this game canon to the comics or the animated series?[/h3]
Because you can choose how the story plays out, the game is not strictly canon to either the comics or the animated series. The characters and the story are authentic to both the comics and animated series, and our dev team works closely with creators of Invincible to ensure everything feels like the Invincible you know and love.

[h3]What platform will the game release on?[/h3]
We’re only planning a release for PC via Steam at this time.
 
[h3]That’s great, I’m reading this on Steam anyway! But when can I play it??[/h3]
Expect to play [i]Invincible Presents: Atom Eve[/i] later this year! We know, we know… you had to wait for a Season 2 release date for a while. But we’ll share the release date as soon as we have one to share!


What’s next? Tell us what you want to know! We love to hear from our fans, and make sure to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2060870]Follow the game on the Store page[/url] so that you get future updates like these sent directly to your Steam News Hub!
